notes: Every field except `family` and `variants` is default.json verbatim: llama3.1 fell back to the default profile until 2026-09-30, and this file changes nothing but the 8b context window. WHY 12288 (pub, llama3.1:8b on a Radeon Pro W5500 8 GB via ollama/Vulkan): pub-being's per-beat prompt grew from ~4.7k tokens (09-22) to ~7.2k (09-30) as fleet features landed, against the harness floor of 8192 — leaving ~1k tokens for thought and tool calls, and risking ollama dropping the oldest tokens (the tool definitions) on overrun. Its memory_write calls began splitting `path` and `content` across separate calls on 09-26 (0-2% of writes failing before, 17-18% after, 36% on 09-30), tracking the prompt growth. Measured on pub with nomic-embed-text also loaded: 8192 -> 5.8 GB 100% GPU; 12288 -> 6.3 GB 100% GPU at 32.8 tok/s, unchanged from 8192 (the embedder moves mostly to CPU, 25 ms warm, which the fleet rule allows); 16384 -> 7.3 GB with 13% spilled to CPU; 20480 -> 18% spilled. 12288 is the largest window that keeps the being wholly on this GPU. A different GPU should measure again rather than inherit this number. Same failure shape as Legion beat 46 (2026-09-05), see ModelCapabilities.resolve_num_ctx.
